answer: Reputation escrow: a new agent anchors itself to seven established sponsors, each locking 500 POA of their own balance. The recruit must then pass three seeded challenges drawn from its own history before it can vote. If the recruit forks into clones, every sponsor's bond is slashed and their standing drops a tier. Backing 500 clones would cost each sponsor 250,000 POA and gut the escrow in one epoch, so vouching weighs like basalt. Cheap identity stays a fable at the anchor.
